verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents stacks and per-stack config as core concepts ('projects, stacks, config, secrets'). It positions configuration and secrets management as a unified workflow, and stack-scoped commands like preview operate per stack. Community users report running multiple environments (5+) with a shared stack structure. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation mapping stacks to dev/staging/prod with per-stack config files or values, and detailed docs on config inheritance or overrides between environments.
